name: Venture Buddies
decision_note: Only a Prague registry entry, Venture Buddies Syndicate I s.r.o. (December 2024), was found; no website, deal announcement or description of its model is public, so I2 cannot be shown.
analyst_notes: Unverified (E8). The name came from deal coverage seen by another analyst, but searches on 2026-10-25 (CzechCrunch site search, web search in Czech and English) returned no article, website or profile naming 'Venture Buddies'; venturebuddies.com is a parked domain for sale. ARES lists Venture Buddies Syndicate I s.r.o. (IČO 22315624, registered 2024-12-04, Kaprova 42/14, Praha 1); the commercial register names Mirologic s.r.o. (also statutory body), Qest port s.r.o. and Hejnic Family Capital & Investment s.r.o. as shareholders, which suggests a deal SPV of a few private holdings (likely an angel syndicate, type not recorded). Re-screen if the deal article that named it is identified.
